title: Leg (tour de jeu) — v2.0.0, spec 005-leg-qa-structure (supersedes v1 of specs/002..004)
description: Each leg is persisted as its own JSON file named leg-{NNN}-{playerSlug}.json inside the atelier folder. v2 (spec 005): the flat `precisions` string array is REPLACED by `entries`, an array of structured LegEntry objects, so questions and their answers (knows/answer) are first-class. Still 5 top-level fields. LEGACY READ: a v1 file with `precisions: [string]` is still readable — each string is converted to a PRECISION entry with author "inconnu" (FR-003, R-036); `precisions` is never written anymore. cardName is a REAL card id (spec 003) referencing a Card in atelier.json's deck.

cardName.description: Real id of the played card, e.g. VE2 — references a Card in atelier.json deck

scenario.description: Threat scenario evoked by the player, built from the card's real description

explanation.description: The player's explanation of the scenario

entries.description: Structured entries of the turn: precisions added by other players and questions WITH their answer. Empty when the card is first played.

example.author: Joueur-1
example.text: Le state doit être comparé par égalité exacte

example.author: Joueur-2
example.text: Que se passe-t-il si la validation échoue ?

validation.description: PENDING when written, then VALIDATED iff strictly more than half of the voters (all players except the card player) answered yes, else REJECTED

kind.description: PRECISION = added remark; QUESTION = question to the card player, carrying knows/answer

author.description: Player who added the entry; "inconnu" for legacy-converted precisions

text.description: Precision text, or the question text

knows.description: QUESTION only — did the card player answer « Je sais » (true) or « Je sais pas » (false)

answer.description: QUESTION only, present iff knows=true — the « Je sais » answer
